resources.string: Backups and reinstall

Save a copy of TalkBack and Google\'s speech now, while they work. If one day they break or an update breaks them, you can reinstall them from here without the Internet or a store. Each copy takes the same space as the app.

Rescue voice (Pico)
Rescue voice (Pico)

Accessible Rescue includes a system speech engine that works without the Internet and without Google: Pico. If your usual speech engine breaks, you can choose this one in the text-to-speech settings and TalkBack will speak again.
Included voices
Try this voice
This is the rescue voice. It works without the Internet.
The voice could not be tried. The technical log has the details.
Open the text-to-speech settings
To use it with TalkBack: in the text-to-speech settings, choose «Preferred engine» and then «Rescue voice (Pico)». On some phones, TalkBack has its own speech engine setting.
The voices already come inside the app: there is nothing to download.
